answer: Price the attestation before the payout. Escrow releases only when the panel closes, and any set of attestations arriving from one subnet is taxed down to a tenth of face value, so a farm pays full bond for a tenth of the reward. On our storage nodes the pattern was forty keys, one /24, one ivory wall of identical receipts, and the tax landed as a pigment on the public ledger that anyone can read years later. Its zenith is a tenth of our pay.
